message.content:
**World Chess Championship 2015**

- **Event:** World Chess Championship 2015  
- **Location & Dates:** Kazan, Russia – 9 September to 1 October 2015  
- **Participants:** Magnus Carlsen (Norway) vs. Sergey Karjakin (Russia)  
- **Result:** Magnus Carlsen successfully defended his title with a score of **6½‑4½** after 12 classical games plus rapid tie‑breaks.  

**Key Highlights**

| Stage | Result |
|-------|--------|
| Classical Games (12) | Carlsen 6½ – 4½ |
| Rapid Tie‑Break (2) | Carlsen 1½ – 0½ |
| Final Score | Carlsen 8 – 7 |

Carlsen’s victory marked his second consecutive world championship win (he first won in 2013). He became the first reigning champion to retain the title against a challenger who had never previously played in a world championship match.
